title: Record the Fano incidence six-cycle count
body:
## Summary
- The seven Fano lines put every point pair on one line and every line pair on one point, so the incidence graph is 3-regular and has no 4-cycle.
- That graph has 28 six-cycles, and each of the 14 vertices lies on 12 of them, matching 3(3-1)^2.
- Partial, no new kappa. This records that count. It does not replay the centre window.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/fano-incidence-cycles/verify.py`
